geometry: Array of adjacent length-two paths, transverse connectors pinned to identity; every coarse path product I. Shared plaquettes couple neighbouring first links and neighbouring second links. Two transverse faces to the pinned environment per outer direction as specified in the methods.
comparison: Use the same generator, trial family and free oscillator normalization at every length; unadjusted overdamped proposal is corrected by Metropolis. Integrated autocorrelation is a sampler diagnostic. Use independent chains and block intervals.
criterion: Flag a finite-volume warning if at both couplings the 95% upper endpoint at length 8 is below the lower endpoint at length 1 and central ratios fall at each doubling. Four finite volumes cannot disprove a uniform lower bound. An upper trial alone can support a falsification sequence only with analytic control.
qualification: If only a surrogate vacuum or variational projection is available, mark results as model diagnostics; the Wilson-vacuum test stays open.
